summary: Tyler Washington led a review of the first chaos engineering game day on the Detect ingestion pipeline, run by Ravi Gupta in staging at 1.2x peak volume. Node failure recovered in 11 seconds with zero event loss, and the March memory-pressure failure mode now self-heals via the circuit breaker; the April Stratos Cloud payload-threshold issue is also fixed by an adaptive threshold. A network partition test exposed a remaining gap: nodes stayed healthy but stopped receiving events, and alerting took about six minutes to fire because health checks do not verify end-to-end event flow. Ananya Sharma pushed to accelerate the synthetic heartbeat because customers in renewal are asking how silent failures are detected, and the team agreed to ship the internal heartbeat by May 29 with the customer panel in June. The team also agreed to make game days quarterly and add a noisy-neighbor scenario for shared clusters.
